name: Litany
description: Signal buff: the party deals 15% more damage for two turns. Stacks.

name: Penance
description: Wren gives up 15% of her Resolve to heal everyone else.

name: Lapse
description: Chronal. Ignores armor and shields, hurts Echoes. Raises Entropy.

name: Vigil
description: Anchor an ally: they cannot fall below 1 Resolve for two turns. Generates 4 Tempo.

name: Fixed Point
description: Capstone. One party member cannot be taken down for four turns.
